description.en: Adds a draggable status panel to the DeepSeek Harness overlay showing live CPU and memory, disk activity and throughput, per-volume capacity, network state, uptime and battery. Windows only: readings are collected through CIM/WMI by a single read-only host route.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 浮层中加入可拖动的本机状态面板，显示实时的 CPU 与内存占用、磁盘活动与读写吞吐、各磁盘容量、网络状态、运行时长与电池。仅支持 Windows：数据由一条只读 host 路由通过 CIM/WMI 采集。
